title: 手写匹配器量化回溯爆炸（步数而非耗时）
code:
"""手写回溯匹配器，用步数（而非耗时）证明回溯爆炸。"""

def steps_greedy(n):
    """(a+)+c 在 'a'*n + 'b' 上的回溯步数。返回 (步数, 是否匹配)。"""
    s = "a" * n + "b"
    steps = 0

    def aplus(pos):
        nonlocal steps
        ends = []
        p = pos
        while p < len(s) and s[p] == "a":
            p += 1
            ends.append(p)
        steps += len(ends)
        return ends[::-1]          # 贪婪优先：先试最长

    def rep(pos):
        nonlocal steps
        for end in aplus(pos):
            if rep(end):           # 先试「再来一次 a+」
                return True
            steps += 1             # 再试「收尾」
            if end < len(s) and s[end] == "c":
                return True
        return False

    ok = rep(0)
    return steps, ok


def steps_possessive(n):
    """(a++)+c：a++ 一次吃光且不回溯。"""
    s = "a" * n + "b"
    steps = 0
    p = 0
    while p < len(s) and s[p] == "a":
        p += 1
        steps += 1
    steps += 1                     # 检查后继字符
    return steps, (p < len(s) and s[p] == "c")


print("=== (a+)+c 失败输入上的步数增长 ===")
print("%4s %14s %14s %12s" % ("n", "贪婪步数", "占有步数", "步数比"))
prev = None
for n in range(4, 16):
    g, _ = steps_greedy(n)
    pos, _ = steps_possessive(n)
    ratio = "%.1f" % (g / pos)
    print("%4d %14d %14d %12s" % (n, g, pos, ratio))

print()
print("=== 对照：n=20 时的量级 ===")
g20, _ = steps_greedy(20)
p20, _ = steps_possessive(20)
print("贪婪步数 =", g20)
print("占有步数 =", p20)
print("比值     = %.0f 倍" % (g20 / p20))
print()
print("结论：贪婪引擎的步数随 n 指数增长（每次多一个 a，可能切分方式翻倍）；")
print("      占有量词把步数压成线性。这就是「正则回溯炸弹」的量化证据。")
